title: Map Mania
description:
Map Mania
Sessions for basic PAPER map reading and compass skills.
Absolutely all welcome. You don't have to have attended previous sessions to join us. 
Meet in the car park just outside the 30 limit of Welland. ///ascendant.dislikes.throat
We will cover up to 7km very gently, likely less, as the main focus is on the map reading.
Approximately 2 hours (longer if you get us lost 😉)
If you need reading glasses, please bring them. 
Also wear appropriate layers for stop/starting.

title: Thirsty Thursday - 5km - Nag's Head
description:
Meet at the Nag's Head.

Run will be approximately 5km and we'll aim to cover it in around 40-45 minutes. Any hills will be walked or jeffed and no one left behind.

This run is aimed at recent and previous TF cohorts, folk returning from injury and anyone who fancies a social, chatty run.

Please wear high viz and bring a torch so we can be seen. Lighter evenings are coming but they're not here just yet! 

Optional post-r5drink in the Nag's afterwards. 

Please remember to click out if you can no longer make it.
